title: termhost-bench results file (termhost-bench/v1)
description: GENERATED by scripts/termhost-bench/build-schema.mjs from kpi-catalog.mjs — do not edit by hand. One file is one run on one machine in one environment; each row is one setup x variant x N x arm x run. Every KPI is {state, unit, n, value|stats, reason}: an unmeasured KPI carries a reason and no number, and a measured KPI below its minimum n is invalid.

absent.description: An honest absence: a value that is unknown or does not apply, with why.

probe.description: The termhost-probe binary that decoded this run's frames: it may be a shared build from another commit (source primary_shared), so it is identified by its file, not assumed to be harness_commit's. path/source name where it was found; executed_path is the copy pinned in the run directory that the doctor and every probe call ran; size_bytes and sha256 are the copy's, mtime the original's.

capabilities.description: Capability doctor verdicts, keyed by mechanism id (e.g. capture.wgc).

kpiValue.description: The generic KPI value. measured: a number (value or stats) and no reason. unknown / not_applicable: a reason and NO number — an unmeasured KPI is never rendered as 0.

coverage.description: How many of the expected contributors (e.g. sessions) the aggregate covers.

kpis.description: Every catalog KPI, in the {state, ...} shape. None may be omitted.

output_latency_ms.description: Output-to-frame latency (ms). Per visible pane: time from the generator emitting a marker (t_emit, taken just before the write) to the first captured frame carrying that marker.

input_latency_ms.description: Keystroke-to-frame echo latency (ms). In the focused pane while the others stream: time from the probe injecting a key (t_inject) to the first captured frame carrying the generator's echo marker for it.

frame_interval_ms.description: Presented-frame interval (ms). Cadence of the host window's presented updates while streaming: the interval between consecutive captured frames of the measured window.

jank_share.description: Jank share (%). Share of frame intervals longer than twice the display's refresh interval.

switch_latency_ms.description: Session-switch latency (ms). Time from the setup's own automation path being told to show session k to k's newest marker becoming visible.

spawn_latency_ms.description: Session-spawn latency (ms). Time from 'new session' through the setup's own automation path to that session's first marker becoming visible; includes the session shell's start-up (D13).

cpu_pct.description: Host CPU (% of one logical core). Host process-tree CPU, excluding every generator AND its parent session shell (identified from the slot file's PID -> parent PID; reported separately as workload_cpu_pct). The PTY host (conhost.exe / OpenConsole.exe) stays in the host tree, because the host chooses it.

cpu_ms_per_mb.description: Host CPU per MB delivered (ms/MB). Host CPU time over the soak divided by the MB of PTY output the generators wrote in it.

memory_mb.description: Host memory at end of soak (MB). Host-tree private bytes (Windows) / PSS (Linux) at the end of the soak, with the same generator-and-session-shell exclusion as cpu_pct (the excluded workload is workload_memory_mb).

memory_growth_mb_per_min.description: Host memory growth (MB/min). Least-squares slope of the host-tree memory samples over the soak.

memory_mb_per_session.description: Marginal host memory per session (MB/session). Least-squares slope of memory_mb over the N ladder (session shells excluded), for one setup, variant and arm.

gpu_pct.description: Host GPU (%). GPU engine utilisation summed over the host's PIDs.

producer_stall_pct.description: Producer stall (%). Share of generator wall time spent blocked inside write: the mean across sessions, and the worst session.

delivered_ratio.description: Delivered ratio (ratio). Bytes a generator wrote divided by the bytes its profile scheduled over the soak; the minimum across sessions. A generator catching up on a backlog inside the window can exceed 1.

hangs.description: Hangs (count). Intervals of >= 2 s with markers pending and no window update, plus OS 'not responding'. Intervals in which the window was not foreground, was cloaked or occluded, or real operator input occurred are excluded; a run left with too few valid intervals is unknown(occluded) or unknown(operator_activity) instead of a count.

crashes.description: Host crashes (count). Host processes that exited during the run.

marker_loss.description: Marker loss (%). Visible-pane marker sequences that were current in the generator's stream for >= 2 refresh intervals but were never observed, or were observed out of order. A sequence superseded before it was composited is marker_skipped (coalescing), not loss. Same interval exclusion as hangs.

marker_skipped.description: Marker coalescing (%). Visible-pane marker sequences superseded by the next sequence before any composited frame carried them (current for < 2 refresh intervals and never observed): the host coalesced frames, which is not loss. Same interval exclusion as hangs.

degradation_output_latency_ms.description: Output-latency degradation (ratio). output_latency_ms p95 at this N divided by the same setup's p95 at N = 1.

degradation_input_latency_ms.description: Input-latency degradation (ratio). input_latency_ms p95 at this N divided by the same setup's p95 at N = 1.

degradation_cpu_pct.description: Host-CPU degradation (ratio). cpu_pct mean at this N divided by the same setup's mean at N = 1.

workload_cpu_pct.description: Workload CPU (generators + session shells) (% of one logical core). CPU of every generator and its parent session shell — the workload cpu_pct excludes. Identical across setups by construction unless a host throttles its producers.

workload_memory_mb.description: Workload memory (generators + session shells) (MB). Private bytes (Windows) / PSS (Linux) of every generator and its parent session shell at the end of the soak — the workload memory_mb excludes.

compositor_cpu_pct.description: Compositor CPU (attributed to no setup) (% of one logical core). CPU of the machine's compositor — dwm.exe on Windows, the X server on linux-xvfb. Shared by everything on the machine, so it is recorded separately and attributed to no setup.

compositor_memory_mb.description: Compositor memory (attributed to no setup) (MB). Private bytes / PSS of the machine's compositor at the end of the soak.

wsl_vm_cpu_pct.description: WSL VM CPU (tmux-wsl; attributed to no setup) (% of one logical core). CPU of the shared WSL VM process for the tmux-wsl setup; not_applicable to every other setup. Shared by everything in WSL, so it is attributed to no setup.

wsl_vm_memory_mb.description: WSL VM memory (tmux-wsl; attributed to no setup) (MB). Memory of the shared WSL VM process at the end of the soak; tmux-wsl only.

diagnostics.description: Runner-only diagnostics, every one labelled non-comparable (D1).
